applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Luke 2:48-49 counts as an unanswered witness by saying it was answered in named earlier rounds.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge says the verse was answered, the rule requires that it not be counted, and the text does not count it as an unanswered witness.
